title: HolidayCheck Reviews & Rating Intelligence
description: Collect and enrich structured HolidayCheck hotel reviews. Use only where you have a lawful basis and any permission required for the intended use.

startUrls.title: HolidayCheck hotel or review URLs
startUrls.description: Direct HolidayCheck hotel, review, offer, media, or contribution URLs. Multiple hotels are supported. Billing is per delivered review row; with cross-run deduplication enabled, already-seen reviews are not re-emitted and not re-billed.

collectionMode.title: Collection mode
collectionMode.description: All ignores the row limit and walks every available page. Limit returns at most the configured count. Since stops at the date boundary.

maxReviewsPerHotel.title: Maximum reviews per hotel
maxReviewsPerHotel.description: Used only in Limit mode. A limited run leaves a resumable checkpoint.

cutoffDate.title: Only reviews on or after
cutoffDate.description: Required in Since mode. Use YYYY-MM-DD and Newest sorting.

resumeFromCheckpoint.title: Resume incomplete collections
resumeFromCheckpoint.description: Continue an interrupted or limited collection at its next saved page.

deduplicateAcrossRuns.title: Skip review IDs seen in earlier runs
deduplicateAcrossRuns.description: Uses the named state store to emit only newly observed review IDs.

resetState.title: Reset saved state for these hotels
resetState.description: Clears checkpoints, seen IDs, daily anomaly history, and persistent monthly trend aggregates for the input hotels before collecting. Content-addressed AI cache records are retained.

stateStoreName.title: Persistent state store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store used for checkpoints, seen review IDs, anomaly baselines, and AI cache.

includeAspectScores.title: Include native aspect scores
includeAspectScores.description: Create eight deterministic scores from HolidayCheck rating and topic fields.

includeAiAspectScores.title: Analyze full review text with AI
includeAiAspectScores.description: Score the same eight aspects from full text with exact-substring evidence and combine them with native signals. Requires an OpenAI API key and may incur charges.

aiAspectModel.title: AI aspect model
aiAspectModel.description: OpenAI model used for evidence-validated full-text aspect analysis.

aiAspectBatchSize.title: Reviews per aspect request
aiAspectBatchSize.description: Maximum number of review texts included in one AI aspect request.

aiAspectMaxConcurrency.title: Aspect-request concurrency
aiAspectMaxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of AI aspect requests processed at the same time.

ignoreAiAspectErrors.title: Continue when AI aspect analysis fails
ignoreAiAspectErrors.description: Keep rows with unavailable AI scores and an error field instead of failing the run.

includeTrendIntelligence.title: Build monthly aspect trends
includeTrendIntelligence.description: Persist and store monthly averages, positive share, month-over-month delta, three-month rolling average, and direction in ASPECT_TRENDS.

includeAnomalySignals.title: Include observable anomaly signals
includeAnomalySignals.description: Adds writing-pattern metrics, exact/near duplicates, rating runs, reviewer history, and historical burst z-scores. These fields are not fake-review verdicts.

includeReviewerDetails.title: Include reviewer profile details
includeReviewerDetails.description: Include displayed name, age group, profile ID, and public-profile flag. Disabled by default for data minimization.

includeOwnerResponses.title: Include hotel owner responses
includeOwnerResponses.description: Keep publicly displayed hotel owner responses in the normalized review row.

includeRawContributions.title: Include raw contribution blocks
includeRawContributions.description: Keep source contribution blocks for audit or custom downstream processing. Disabled by default to reduce output size.

includeCompetitorSet.title: Build an automatic competitor set
includeCompetitorSet.description: Rank nearby and location-based alternatives with transparent similarity and source reasons.

competitorLimit.title: Competitors per hotel
competitorLimit.description: Maximum number of selected comparable competitors returned for each target hotel.

competitorStarTolerance.title: Star-class tolerance
competitorStarTolerance.description: Maximum absolute difference in star class allowed between target and competitor.

includePriceIntelligence.title: Add comparable live price bands
includePriceIntelligence.description: Fetch a best available offer for the target and every competitor using the exact same dates, occupancy, currency, offer type, and optional board filters.

priceSearch.title: Comparable price search
priceSearch.description: Required when price intelligence is enabled.

checkIn.title: Check-in or package departure
checkIn.description: Arrival date for hotel-only searches or departure date for package searches, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

checkOut.title: Check-out or package return
checkOut.description: Departure date for hotel-only searches or return date for package searches, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult guests used for every offer in the comparable price search.

childrenAges.title: Children's ages
childrenAges.description: One age from 0 to 17 for each child.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Number of rooms used for every offer in the comparable price search.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code requested for target and competitor offers.

offerType.title: Offer type
offerType.description: Compare hotel-only offers or package offers; all targets and competitors use the same type.

departureAirports.title: Departure airport codes
departureAirports.description: Optional IATA codes for package searches. Empty means any supported airport.

boardTypes.title: HolidayCheck board filter codes
boardTypes.description: Optional HolidayCheck codes such as GT06-AI. Empty means any board.

priceBandTolerancePercent.title: Same-price-band tolerance
priceBandTolerancePercent.description: A competitor within plus or minus this percentage of the target nightly price is in the same band.

includeManagementReport.title: Create a management report
includeManagementReport.description: Creates JSON and email-ready HTML portfolio reports plus explainable action alerts.

reportLanguage.title: Management report language
reportLanguage.description: Language used for the generated HTML, JSON labels, text digest, and action alerts.

alertAspectDeclineThreshold.title: Aspect decline alert threshold
alertAspectDeclineThreshold.description: Create an alert when a monthly aspect score falls by at least this amount on the -1 to 1 scale.

alertMinimumReviewCount.title: Minimum reviews for a trend alert
alertMinimumReviewCount.description: Suppress aspect decline alerts based on smaller monthly samples.

notificationWebhookUrl.title: Notification webhook URL
notificationWebhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint for a signed JSON digest. Connect it to your own email, Slack, Teams, Make, or Zapier workflow.

notificationWebhookSecret.title: Webhook signing secret
notificationWebhookSecret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret. When set, the request includes X-HolidayCheck-Signature.

notificationMode.title: When to send a notification
notificationMode.description: Choose whether the signed webhook is sent for alerts, every completed report, or failed health states.

ignoreNotificationErrors.title: Continue when notification delivery fails
ignoreNotificationErrors.description: Keep the Actor run successful and expose the delivery failure in health output instead of throwing.

translateToEnglish.title: Translate review text to English
translateToEnglish.description: Translate title, full review, and owner response while preserving originals. Requires an OpenAI API key and may incur charges.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Encrypted secret used for AI aspects and/or translation. OPENAI_API_KEY may be used instead.

translationModel.title: Translation model
translationModel.description: OpenAI model used to translate review content into English.

translationBatchSize.title: Reviews per translation request
translationBatchSize.description: Maximum number of reviews included in one translation request.

translationMaxConcurrency.title: Translation concurrency
translationMaxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of translation requests processed at the same time.

ignoreTranslationErrors.title: Continue when translation fails
ignoreTranslationErrors.description: Keep original review rows and expose the translation error instead of failing the run.

aiMaxRequests.title: Maximum AI requests per run
aiMaxRequests.description: Shared safety budget across AI aspect and translation requests.

aiMaxInputTokens.title: Maximum AI input tokens per run
aiMaxInputTokens.description: Shared preflight input-token safety budget across AI features.

useAiCache.title: Reuse AI results from the state store
useAiCache.description: Caches by feature version, model, and source-content hash.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum hotel concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of target hotels collected at the same time.

maxRequestRetries.title: Request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum retry count for a failed HolidayCheck HTTP request.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to wait for one HolidayCheck HTTP request before retrying or failing it.

ignoreUrlErrors.title: Continue when a hotel fails
ignoreUrlErrors.description: Isolate a failed hotel URL, record its error, and continue processing the remaining hotels.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy is recommended for larger recurring collections.
